text: Coffee with Fiona after drop-off. Her youngest, Rohan, starts P1 on 19 August and she's dreading it more than he is. Must text her that morning.
Jamal's dad passed away on Sunday. Funeral is Thursday the 9th at 11am at the crematorium. He sounded flat on the phone. I'm going with Kieran.
Aditi's turning 40 on 3rd of March. She's mad about bouldering at the moment and keeps saying her chalk bag is falling apart. Good gift shout.

Long catch-up with Krisztina. She and Chris split up in the summer, she's moved back in with her mum in Leith for now. Seems okay, a bit raw still. She's started pottery classes on Tuesday nights which she loves. Said Chris kept the dog, Biscuit, which stung. Check in on her next week.
Sean got made redundant on Friday, no warning. Final day is 30/11. He's putting a brave face on but Eilidh says he's not sleeping. Need to ring him at the weekend.
Ann's granddaughter Aoife graduates from Glasgow on 4 July, first in the family to go to uni. Ann is beyond proud. Send a card.
Irina said Lachlan's leaving do is off, he's decided to stay on after all.
Helen and Chen are celebrating ten years married on the 22nd. Dinner at that Italian place on Byres Road. Chen asked me not to mention it.
Joseph's exams start Monday at 9, maths first. He's properly nervous, barely eating according to his mum. Text him good luck Sunday night!
Picked up the suit from the dry cleaner. Still need to sort the car MOT before 14/05.
Ran into Xavier at the shop. His daughter Asha passed her driving test this morning, third time lucky. He's buzzing.
Jen called. Her nan died last night, peacefully. Funeral probably next week, she'll let me know. She's taking time off work. Drop round with food on Wednesday evening?
Rebecca mentioned her son starts nursery on the 2nd of September. She's going back to work three days a week at the council after that.
Ximena is into vinyl in a big way, mostly old Cuban stuff. Birthday 17 Jan. Record token maybe.
Anya and Aleksander are expecting, due in April! Told us over dinner. Anya's had terrible morning sickness though. Aleksander is already painting the nursery.
Chloe from work got the promotion to team lead, starts it after the Christmas break. Need to say congrats properly tomorrow morning.
Dev's mum is having her hip done on the 12th at half 9. He's taking her in. Remind me to message him that afternoon to see how it went.

Long call with Abebe tonight. He finished his PhD viva on Monday and passed with minor corrections, graduation is 6th of December. His partner Hoang has just been offered a job in Manchester so they're probably moving in the new year, which Abebe is nervous about because he's never lived outside Edinburgh. They're having a small celebration at theirs Saturday at 7. Hoang's vegetarian, so I'll bring the mushroom thing. Should get Abebe a proper pen or something for graduation.
Sam's cat Pickle has to have a tooth out on Friday. Sam is weirdly anxious about it.
Aarav got into Edinburgh for medicine!! Yasmin was in tears telling me. He starts in September.
Fiona says Jamal's not doing great since the funeral. She's going round tomorrow afternoon. I should text him too, nothing heavy.
Kieran's birthday is the 28th. He's been banging on about wanting a decent pizza oven. Split it with Aditi?
Krisztina's brother Sean (not my Sean) is getting married in Budapest on 5 June. She's maid of honour, sort of. Flying out the Wednesday before.
Note to self: dentist moved to Thursday at 4.
Chris was made redundant from the bank in March and has just started a new job at a charity. Much happier. His wife Eilidh is training for the Loch Ness marathon on 29 September.
Ann says Helen's hubby Joseph was diagnosed with type 2 diabetes. He's struggling with the diet stuff. Helen's stressed.

Lunch with Aoife and Irina. Aoife's wee one, Lachlan, had his first day at school today, cried at the gate then forgot about it. Irina's mum is in hospital again, chest infection, she's going up to Inverness on the 15th. Don't forget to ask Irina how her mum is.
Chen loves bonsai. Has about twelve. Also hates coriander.
Xavier's son Rohan has his Higher music exam, performance part, on 11 March at 2pm. Practising cello every night. Rohan says he's fine but Xavier thinks he's terrified.
Jen and her boyfriend broke up last week, she ended it. Seemed relieved honestly. She's off to Lisbon with her sister Rebecca on the 3rd to clear her head.
Asha's 18th is on Saturday. Party at the rugby club from 8pm. I'm doing the cake.
Ximena's grandad died back in May. She mentioned the anniversary of it is coming up and she's been feeling low. Call her next Sunday.

Catch up with Anya. She's been signed off work with stress since the restructure, meeting with HR on 2 November about possible redundancy. Her husband Dev is being great apparently. She's thinking about retraining as a primary teacher. I need to send her that course link I mentioned.
Aleksander's niece Chloe got her Standard Grade results, all As. He's chuffed.
Must order flowers for Abebe's mum's funeral, Friday 10:30, St Mary's.
Hoang is fostering a greyhound called Pepper. Thinking of adopting her permanently. Lives in a flat in Marchmont though, landlord might not like it.
Sam said Aarav and Yasmin's housewarming is next Saturday afternoon. Yasmin wants plants for the new place, apparently anything but cacti.
Fiona's birthday tomorrow! Get a card first thing.
Jamal mentioned his sister Aditi is doing a 10k for the hospice that looked after their dad, Sunday 13 October at 10am. Sponsor her.
Kieran Wright, aka Kez, is back from Australia for good. Living at his parents' in Stirling until he finds a flat. Starts at the uni library on Monday.
Krisztina's daughter has her first ballet show on the 14th at 6pm. She asked if I'd come. I said yes, need to book the afternoon off.
Sean and Eilidh's twins finish nursery on 27 June, they're having a wee ceremony with mortarboards and everything. Eilidh's mum is coming down from Aberdeen for it.

Ann's not great. Her brother Joseph died suddenly on the 2nd, heart attack. Funeral was Saturday. She keeps saying she's fine. I think I should pop round once a week for a bit. Her daughter Helen is staying with her until the end of the month.
Bought the train tickets for Leeds, 9 Nov, 7:15 out of Waverley.
Aoife says Irina's interview for the head of department job is on Tuesday at 1pm. Irina hasn't told anyone at work.
Lachlan is obsessed with Lego Technic right now. His birthday is 1st of February. Ask his mum which sets he has already.
Helen and Chen called off the trip to Japan, Chen's dad isn't well. They're going to Skye instead in the October holidays.

Long walk with Joseph and Xavier. Joseph's daughter Rebecca starts uni in Dundee in two weeks, studying architecture, and he's not coping well with the idea of an empty house. Xavier's just been made redundant from the council, last day is 31/10, but he sounds weirdly upbeat, says he's always wanted to go freelance. Xavier's wife Jen is less sure. Need to remember to ask Joseph how the move-in day goes, it's Saturday the 14th.
Rohan's graduation from the police college is 20 December at noon. His mum is flying in from Delhi. He asked me to come along.
Rang Asha. Her grandmother's funeral went okay yesterday, lots of people came. She's back at work Monday but wobbly. Check in Wednesday.
Ximena's partner Anya plays in a ceilidh band, gig at the Queen's Hall on Friday at half 8. Ximena wants a group of us to go.
Fridge is making the noise again. Call the engineer before the weekend.
Aleksander says his boss is retiring at Christmas and he might go for the job. Would be a huge step.
Chloe Kim's son Dev just finished his first week at secondary. Hated day one, loved day three. She says he's already got a girlfriend, apparently.
Abebe's twins turn 5 on 30th of April. They're into dinosaurs and the Gruffalo. Party at soft play.
Hoang finally heard back, he didn't get the Glasgow job. Gutted. Says he's fine but he really wanted it. Message him tomorrow evening.
Sam's mum had her biopsy results today, all clear. Massive relief.

Had a drink with Aarav. He and Yasmin have been fighting a lot, he thinks it might be over. He's not sleeping. Their anniversary is next month, on the 18th, which makes it all worse. I said I'd meet him for lunch on Thursday at 1.

Phoned Irina back. Her uncle Aleksander's funeral is in Poland on 8 November so she's flying out the 6th, early morning flight. Her son Lachlan has his prelims the week she's away and she's anxious about leaving him, but her husband Chen will be home. Lachlan's 16th is 21/11 too, he wants trainers, the chunky ones. I said I'd keep an eye on Lachlan. Should text her on the 8th.
Quiet one. Jamal's back at work, Fiona's fine, Kieran was off sick. Nothing much to report.
